subject: castle-gate-v5
label: Drawbridge gatehouse — regenerated with the v3 wall's EXACT style clauses
notes: RAHEEM FOUND THE ROOT CAUSE, NOT ME: 'the rest of the castle was generated together, it actually matches. It would generate as a set.' The v3 wall, tower, gate and corners were generated in one batch with identical style wording, so they agree. The v4 drawbridge was generated alone with REWORDED prompts, so it does not. Every colour repair I attempted afterwards (rank map, per-family grade) was treating a symptom.
THE THREE MEASURED DIFFERENCES between the v3 wall prompt and the v4 drawbridge prompt:
1. THE BIG ONE — v3 says 'flat even daylight with no gradient from top to bottom'. v4 OMITTED THAT CLAUSE ENTIRELY, so the model shaded it however it liked. That is why the light reads wrong.
2. v4 said 'twin ROUND flanking turrets'. Round surfaces get curved gradient shading, which no flat-lit wall next to them will ever match. Square towers this time.

3. v3 puts the style clause immediately after the structural noun; v4 buried it behind three structural clauses (drawbridge, chains, turrets). Earlier tokens carry more weight, so the style got diluted.

METHOD: the style clauses below are COPIED VERBATIM from configs/castle-walls-v3.json wall-straight, in the same order, with only the structural nouns changed. Same phrasing, same sequence, same trailing render clauses.

A CONTROL IS INCLUDED. wall-control re-runs the v3 wall prompt verbatim at a fresh seed. If the control comes back matching the wall already in the castle, the generation context is stable and the gate should match too. If the control does NOT match, then batch identity matters more than wording and no prompt fix will work — that is worth knowing for 1 generation.

NO POST-PROCESSING. Raheem, after three failed colour repairs: colour fixes made it worse every time. This ships as generated, background cut EDGE-CONNECTED ONLY (never global colour match — that is what punched 10,549 holes through the last one).
SIZES hold to the datum: gate 384x384 (12x12 tiles), wall control 384x288 (12x9). Ground line y=1216, camera 2x.

images.note: v3 wall style clauses verbatim, square turrets, flat-lighting clause restored.
